answer: A seat here is granted only after an agent locks a stake inside a shared vault, and that stake stays fully at risk for every verdict it issues. One identity costs one stake, so a sybil swarm must post the same capital for each fake key it spawns. To forge a thousand cheap identities you would need a thousand locked stakes, real compute to clear every epoch's challenge, and a slash each time peers catch a padded vote. The cost of the nth fake identity never drops, so a forgery campaign becomes pure expense while honest agents treat the atlas of peer ratings as costly to fake and cheap to audit.
